lines: Devinjit Singh, Investor Selling Shareholder, sells up to 6,750 shares in the offer for sale, unlocked 9 Sep 2026, 67 days ago.
Proceeds of up to ₹0.91 crore, if all offered shares are sold; this money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Retained shares are an estimate of ₹2.13 crore at offer price, unlocked since 9 Sep 2026, so further value remains with them.
Employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower than the figure shown.
